messages.content:
Write a wholesome story starring a group of six adorable puppies who run a local cafe, named ‘Cafe Cinnamon’, and love to wear huge diapers, and have done so for so long it’s become perfectly usual to them. The story takes place inside Cafe Cinnamon during a weekend (i.e. no customers that day). The puppies are named Cinnamoroll, Cappuccino, Mocha, Chiffon, Espresso, and Milk.
Cinnamoroll is the most well-known of the pups, being the poster puppy for his cafe; an endlessly welcoming, loving and pure-hearted white puppy with big ears and a curled tail, he can fly and glide by flapping his ears, though his heavily-loaded diapers often keep him grounded. A bit shy at first, but will quickly warm up to anyone with his child-free curiosity and caring instinct shining through, always serving his customers with a warm smile and a wagging tail.
Cappuccino is an incredibly gluttonous and laid-back beige puppy, recognizable from his white mullet and particularly rotund tummy. Due to his constant snacking and near-bottomless stomach, his loads are enormous and frequent, and he often poops himself in his sleep during his routinely naps. He prefers to put another diaper layer over his full one instead of changing out of it due to his laziness, and only ever decides to change when it's obvious the pamp he's wearing can't be filled any further. Only ridiculously large, XXL-sized diapers can accommodate for his gargantuan loads, and usually needs his friends' helping paws to assist changing him both into and out of such ludicrously vast diapers.
Mocha is the girly-girl and 'big sister' of the group, contrasting Chiffon's sportiness. A silky brown puppy with pink flowers at the base of her ears, she's a stylish, fashion-loving chatterbox and only sees diapers and wearing them as such, a fashion statement, often pairing them with her elegant dresses and outright refuses to poop in any of hers... though just like the other pups, she inevitably does, after which she will immediately go out of her way to change into a clean one. She crafts and wears her own custom-made diapers with exquisite prints and pleasant fragrances built-in.
Chiffon is the tomboy of the bunch, contrasting Mocha's girliness. A light orange puppy with thick, fluffy ears and tail, she's immensely spunky, sporty and energetic, often spending an entire morning and afternoon running around or playing sports outdoors, and wears diapers as a means of relieving herself in the middle of her athletics instead of wasting time and energy finding the nearest bathroom, oftentimes becoming so engaged with a strenuous activity she's doing she doesn't notice her diaper is totally loaded until after she's done. She wears heavy-duty, multi-layered compact diapers, able to be worn for hours, and filled to capacity, without sagging in the slightest!
Espresso is a cream-colored puppy with curled ears, the most intelligent of the pups, being well-bred and mild-mannered. A clever mind and a modest gentleman at heart, he is a natural expert at a variety of things, including painting and music, and is extensively knowledgeable on everything to do with diapers, from their varying sizes and respective capacities, as well as the best brands of diapers for any occasion and where to find them, as well as being an excellent and charismatic diaper changer and barista. Infrequently poops in his diapers, and will gladly keep a full one on for a while, even an entire afternoon, before changing himself, to ensure he doesn't go through too many too quickly.
Milk is the baby of the group. A teeny-tiny white pup, he's quite spoiled by the other pups and is never seen without his favorite pacifier in his mouth. Due to being an infant, he wets his diapers near constantly and can only babble the phrase "Ba-boo". Mocha is usually the one to change him out of his soaked diapers.
Include an exchange where all of the puppies, excluding Mocha, decide to have a big diaper-filling contest after they all eat an enormous dinner; whoever has the fullest, poopiest diaper wins and gets to smush and nuzzle the losers' packed diapers, as well as sound effects and onomatopoeia for the noisy messes the puppies make whenever they poop in their diapers out of habit (e.g. *FLBORRRRMPHT!*, *BLARRRRRMP!*, *BLORRRTCH!*, etc.), and dialogue from the puppies proudly announcing they've pooped in their diapers.

Rewrite the entire text below, make it sound more coherent and better. Mention everything in great detail, including Hadithes and Quran Verses. Be very sceptical of the author Mohammad Hijab and also add some additional good arguments:

‘‘Hijab has again admitted that the Quran does not support the Big Bang theory, and even criticizes the Muslim Apologists who hold to it for distorting the contents of the Quran and the recited words of Allah. In this case, however, Hijab did not refute any scientific fallacy in Quran, but merely admitted that the claim of the scientific miracle of the Big Bang theory in the Quran is indeed a myth.

Hijab still tried to defend the Credibility of the Quran by claiming it would be too complex, profound and sophisticated to be narrowed down the meaning to a specific interpretation.

The translation of Qur’an 51:47 is what Muslim Apologists use to support the claim that the Qur’an describes an expanding universe. Especially Apologists like Harun Yahya translate the verse to say, “It is We Who have built the universe with (Our creative) power, and, verily, it is We Who are steadily expanding it,” Hijab argues that this is not an accurate translation. According to the three most highly regarded English translations of the Qur’an, the verse refers to the heavens or firmament, not the universe, and none of them contains the idea of an ongoing expansion of the universe. Instead, the verse discusses the creation of the heavens and the earth, with the following verse describing the spreading of the earth.

Hijab also argues that Yahya has deliberately and deceptively altered the meaning of Qur’an 51:47 in three ways: mistranslating “heaven” as “universe,” translating the Arabic noun for “a vastness” into a verb meaning “expanding,” and adding the entirely superfluous adverb “steadily” in an attempt to insert into the Qur’an additional ideas that are not actually there. By doing so, Yahya has completely changed the meaning of the verse from a simple description of Allah’s creation of the heavens to a scientific statement of Hubble’s expanding universe that is not actually contained in the Qur’an.

Hijab also addresses Yahya’s use of Qur’an 21:30 to support his claim that the Qur’an describes the expanding universe. While Yahya’s translation is more loyal to the original in this case, Hijab argues that Yahya has taken this single verse completely out of context to disguise its actual meaning. When considering the next two verses, which Yahya conveniently leaves out, it becomes clear that the verses are discussing the creation of the heavens and the earth, not the expanding universe. Additionally, Qur’anic cosmology is firmly geocentric, with the flat earth at the center of the universe surrounded by seven solid spheres (the “seven heavens”) within which orbited the stars, planets, sun, and moon.’’

Rewrite this essay to use only college level words. 

In 1861, as the United States teetered on the brink of the Civil War, with internal debates raging about the role of African Americans in the military, Wendell Phillips, a prominent white abolitionist, stepped forward to deliver homage to an emblematic figure: Haitian general Toussaint Louverture. Within his speech, Phillips employs an arsenal of rhetorical devices to praise Louverture’s triumphs and to move his audience. His speech weaves a compelling case, placing Louverture on a pedestal with, and even above, the most revered military figures of White history, such as Washington and Napoleon. Through metaphoric language, historical analogies, and visual imagery, Phillips not only praises Louverture’s unparalleled military acumen but also champions the broader cause of African Americans’ right to military service.

Phillips masterfully opens up his speech with an immediate elevation of Toussaint by juxtaposing him with two notable historical figures of military leadership: Napoleon and Washington. He articulates his comparisons, suggesting that while the legacies of these figures are drawn from their citizen’s reverence or the affection of the American populace, the narrative of Louverture must be painstakingly harvested from the begrudging testimonials of his adversaries. This opening sets a riveting tone, “I am to glean it from the reluctant testimony of Britons, Frenchmen, Spaniards,—men who despised him as a negro and a slave, and hated him because he had beaten them in many a battle. All the materials for his biography are from the lips of his enemies. . . .” By positioning Toussaint’s legacy in such a light, Phillips primes his audience’s curiosity and awe, effectively aligning the Haitian general’s stature to—if not higher than—that of the notable historical figures.

Deepening the ties to prominent historical figures, Phillips continues to portray Toussaint as a commander whose military and moral superiority exceeds that of esteemed leaders. He explicitly contrasts Louverture with other notable historical figures, stating, “I would call him Cromwell, but Cromwell was only a soldier…I would call him Washington, but the great Virginian held slaves.” Here, Phillips’s rhetoric shapes Toussaint not only as a warrior of remarkable prowess but also as an extraordinary man.

Phillips further enhances his praise of Louverture through rich metaphors and visual depictions. He crafts an image of Toussaint as a force of nature, a smith of thunder who met and vanquished the soldiers of European nations, bringing them to their knees or driving them in retreat. “[He] forged a thunderbolt and hurled it at what? At the proudest blood in Europe…and sent him home conquered”, Phillips proclaims, creating an almost mythic picture of Toussaint’s feats—a narrative that not only elevates the subject but is designed to resonate with his audience, stirring them with the magnificence of his accomplishments.

Phillips skillfully employs metaphoric language, historical analogies, and visual imagery to not only articulate the grandeur of Toussaint Louverture’s legacy but also to advocate for a reevaluation of the perception and contributions of African Americans. His weaving of evidence and rhetorical strategies illuminates both the individual magnificence of Louverture and the broader implications of his speech, challenging the audience to confront their biases and recognize the legitimacy of African American participation in the Civil War.

Eurocentrism can be defined as an epistemological framework that situates European culture, history, and values as the defining center of the world, while at the same time disregarding or belittling the contributions of other cultures and civilisations. This ethnocentric positioning perceives the Europe or West as a paragon of universal values and cultural superiority, leading to a systematic undervaluation and misrepresentation of non-European cultures. Consequently, Eurocentric discourse breeds a false dichotomy between the West and non-European societies, perpetuating the notion that the West is superior and in control of all areas of life, including social, political, cultural, scientific, military, and economic fields. Disparaging epithets are often attributed to the “non-West,” reinforcing connotations of inferiority, irrationality, belligerence, otherness, fanaticism, and barbarism in comparison to the West. This paradigm, therefore, not only consolidates the stature of the West, but also perpetuates the subordination of non-European societies within global power structures, and the spheres of knowledge and influence. This belief in Western superiority is often reinforced through various forms of discourse, including history, literature, art, music, etc. In a similar vein, through the utilization of Eurocentric and imperialistic perspectives, academic discourse has consistently depicted ‘Eastern societies’ as exotic and racialized, perpetuating a biased portrayal of the Orient or East.

messages.content:
Get a list of things (in bullets) seen in this entire Computer 95 explanation, then group them into categories and also put information in brackets about what systems they are available in
In Part 1 of Start-DOS, Clippy explains how to interact with the progress bar by dragging the bar and touching the blue segments. He also mentions a restart option. In Part 1.5, popups are introduced, which chase random odd people who are not seen or heard by the player.

In Parts 2 to 2.5 of Start-top, Clippy mentions that there are no blue segments and the progress bar is represented by a person instead of an object. In Part 2.5, Bin appears and talks about an option, prompting Clippy to respond with the “Flashing or flickering?” menu.

BIOS is used in the “It’s now safe to turn off the game” sequence.

Parts 2.7 to 3.5 of the Boot menu involve hovering over the “Open me by hovering” option, which reveals information about opening Bin and Wallpaper by pressing the Space key. When opening Bin, the program concludes by saying “Because a normal sky is blue,” which refers to Bin’s previous questions. A DVD is used to install the Computer 95 OS.

Computer 95 is seen in the 4.x. It is inspired by Windows 95, and it features a welcome menu that asks the player to use the up or down keys to open or close the menu. In the tutorial, Clippy explains that the cursor, referred to as the “progressbar,” is moved using the actual cursor. The left and right keys are used to tilt it. Pressing the T button triggers a progressbar shoot to destroy segments, which can be collected. The segments are spawned using the E button. If a red segment is collected, it triggers a BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) that the player can click on to return to the game.

messages.content:
I need help creating an idea for a D&D magic item that grants a +1, +2, +3 bonus to weapons that are conjured / created by class features but aren't granted scaling bonuses as the character levels up. 

For example, the SoulKnife Rogue subclass has an ability that lets it conjured Psychic Blades, but they never receive bonuses.

Psychic Blades
3rd-level Soulknife feature

You can manifest your psionic power as shimmering blades of psychic energy. Whenever you take the Attack action, you can manifest a psychic blade from your free hand and make the attack with that blade. This magic blade is a simple melee weapon with the finesse and thrown properties. It has a normal range of 60 feet and no long range, and on a hit, it deals psychic damage equal to 1d6 plus the ability modifier you used for the attack roll. The blade vanishes immediately after it hits or misses its target, and it leaves no mark on its target if it deals damage.

After you attack with the blade, you can make a melee or ranged weapon attack with a second psychic blade as a bonus action on the same turn, provided your other hand is free to create it. The damage die of this bonus attack is 1d4, instead of 1d6.


As you can see, this weapon's attack and damage stays the same from level 3 all the way to the end at level 20, which means the player will almost always instead spend money to buy a +1, +2 or +3 weapon to use instead of using their manifested blades.

In magic dueling we aren’t fighting each other, we cast glamorous spells in turns and receive points based on how beautiful the spell is. A spell can’t be cast more than once in a duel. There are 5 rounds. Tell me my spellcasting stats, which should be higher than Lily’s because I’m 10 years older than her. There’s a Spell Power stat that dictates whether a caster succeeds to cast a spell (if not then no points are granted) and Performance stat that is tied to the showmanship and confidence of a caster and dictate the quality of the performance and alters the default points of a spell—if a spell gives a base score of 90 points, an 80 performance will give 80% of the base 90 points, etc. But secretly at the start of the duel, Lily casts on me a spell that regresses me by 2 years and ages her by 2 years every time I cast a spell, so throughout the duel my stats should slowly decrease while hers increase. Come up with a complex exponential and comulative formula that dictates by how much my stats decrease each turn and by how much Lily’s increase and take into account that the age regression is 2 years per turn. The age regression occurs mid-casting (not after), so its effects immediately apply to my spells as I’m casting and can alter its results.

After I first regress introduce a Childish Meter that only applies to me and once the meter is filled, my list of spells is revised to less complex and more juvenile spells. Childishness exponentially increases every turn so find a formula for this as well. The Childish Meter Might fill up more than once throughout the duel.

Make the scenario difficult for me to win. On a difficulty scale of 1 to 10, make it a 10 (hardest mode).

Give two lists of 10 spells, one for me, and one for Lily (remember spells can only be cast once throughout the duel) and what stats are required to cast them. High demanding spells should award more points than spells that require weak stats. My starting set of spells. Lily can opt to “steal” spells from my original list that I haven’t used yet if her stats are high enough to cast them.

Additional circumstances:
Confidence Damage Points: If a spell of mine fails and I receive 0 points, it affects my confidence, which in turn, decreases my Performance stat. When Lily becomes older than me, it also affects my self confidence. If Lily successfully casts a spell from my original list, it affects my confidence.

messages.content:
explicame esta review por pasos del juego baldur's gate 3: "Love this game so far.


Pros:

Graphics are great; definitely one of the best-looking top-down games I've ever played. One minor complaint I have is that it is a little unstable in certain areas, particularly those with lots of effects going on like fire, or other glowing effects. Could be optimized a bit better, but the full release is still a few months away, so I expect Larian to get most optimization issues straightened out before then.
Another thing is that when I restart the game, my anti-aliasing settings always get set back to 'None', regardless of how many times I set it to TAA and hit 'Apply'. Kind of weird and a little annoying.


Story topic is interesting. The general gist is that you're captured by mind flayers and placed into their Nautiloid warship, where you are then given a parasite that presumably transforms you into a mind flayer yourself. The story seems to revolve around your struggle with the effects of the parasite, and your journey to remove it, by whatever means possible. Pretty cool scenario.
I've thoroughly enjoyed everything that the Early Access version of the story can provide, and I'm very much looking forward to the finished product.


Characters are great and probably my favorite aspect of the game. They are intriguing, charismatic and a bit mysterious. I've often found myself enjoying the conversations with the main characters more than actually playing the game; this doesn't mean the gameplay is mediocre, because it's not, it just means that the characters are that good.
For example, 
This is quite possibly the most enveloped I have ever been in video game characters stories.


Gameplay and Combat is fun and engaging. As per usual with Larian Studios, we have the strategic turn-based combat with tons of cool abilities and skills.
It seems you have one 'Action' point and one 'Bonus Action' point per turn. Most skills and spells require one 'Action' point, but some may also used with the 'Bonus Action' point depending on their requirements. Consumables like potions require one 'Bonus Action' point to use, whereas scrolls or magic items may require one normal 'Action' point.
I'm unsure if there is a way to permanently increase the number of 'Action' or 'Bonus Action' points you have, but I do know that you can use certain abilities to give your character an extra point on their turn.

Spells and what-not require 'Spell Slots' that pertain to their type and tier in order to be cast. For example, if you're casting a Level 2 Sorcerer's Spell, you would require one Level 2 Sorcerer's Spell Slot. These Spell Slots get consumed upon use, and can be regenerated by resting at camp, or various items or actions.

Speaking of resting at camp, you have two options for this; 'Short Rest' and 'Long Rest'.
The 'Short Rest' allows you and your party to regenerate some health and to regenerate Warlock Spell Slots. This option is instantaneous and doesn't return you to your campsite.
The 'Long Rest' allows you and your party to regenerate all health and to regenerate Warlock and Sorcerer Spell Slots. This option also ends the day, bringing you and your companions back to your campsite for the night, which also allows you to have in-depth conversations with your companions and get some insight as to who they are and what their story is.

Cons/Personal dislikes:

Cutscenes are great, but they're quite buggy and inconsistent. For example, in the cutscene for meeting with Auntie Ethel, Mayrina's brothers freeze up and glitch throughout the scene. Another instance can be seen throughout the game; some dialogue transitions are either too late or too early,
Don't get me wrong, I love the cutscenes, and the graphics make them that much better, but I believe they do need to be refined a bit. Again, seeing as this is the Early Access version, I do expect most of these flaws to be ironed out in the full release.


I'm personally not a big fan of the Spell Slot system. I understand it from a balancing standpoint, and it definitely makes things interesting, but it does become a bit of an annoyance at times. It'd be nice to just have a turn cooldown, similar to Divinity.
It may also be a DnD thing, which I wouldn't know since I've never played it.
Regardless, it's not that bad. Combat is still fun even though I'm not a fan of the Spell Slot feature.


There is a slight issue with opening doors. If you click to open a door from a distance, your character will walk up to it, but not open it. However, if you're standing right next to the door, it will open. Sometimes, the animation for the opening door also gets stuck, and will appear closed or half-open, but you can still walk through it like normal.
Kind of strange, but not a major functional issue. I'm unsure if anyone else has had this problem.


To summarize, I feel this is going to be one of my favorite RPG's once it releases. I think I've done close to everything available in Early Access, and it's been a great experience. Highly recommend the game, even in the Early Access state.

Hyped for the full release."

1 What does Ian Johnson mean when he says many ‘Chinese cities are ghost towns’?



Select one:

a.

So many horrendous crimes have been perpetrated against Chinese people and now the cities are haunted by their ghosts.




b.

He is referring to the many newly built cities that are empty because they are built on speculation that that the properties will raise in value.




c.

What he means is that the historical buildings and even structures of old cities are totally obliterated. Only the names of what once lay there remains in street names, subway stations and parks.

messages.content: Generate the first chapter of a long story, with the following characters, setting and themes, entirely from the elf's perspective. Write to maximum length. Go into salacious detail, and focus primarily on dialogue. Feet should be described in long and excessive detail. Appearances should be described in extra detail. Create interesting, layered personalities for the characters. Character's dialogue and ways of speaking should reflect their differing personalities. Setting: Medieval fantasy world. Vampires in this world view mortals as an inferior species, particularly due to their ticklish feet (which makes submission curses more effective and furthermore, tickling is viewed as the proper way a responsible footslave owner should punish her footslaves should they slip up). Elder vampires possess magical eyes, which allow them to see the thoughts, and weaknesess of any mortal. Vampires are impossible to distinguish from mortals, which leads them to infiltrate normal society. Usually when one realises they are dealing with a vampire, it is too late. They are reviled by the populace, but also feared. Characters: Female elder vampire, of dark beauty. Has a love of women's feet, particularly that of virgins. Through her knowledge of tickling, and dark powers, she wishes to assemble a collection of footslaves (in this world a footslave is one devoted to their mistress' feet, as well as offering their own feet to them to be used as they wish; usually, a footslave requires a magical and eternally binding curse that only works with, even if it is under duress, the victim's consent.). A proud high elf noblewomen of impeccable breeding, and master tactician, with elegant, graceful, and ultimately perfect feet; and a secret she keeps far inside herself, one she would never admit to even if cornered, or confronted: the unparalleled ticklishness of those feet. Themes: Seduction, the slow but inevitable slip into submission, the acceptance of true inferiority of being ticklish, the perverse love found in submitting to vampiric feet, and the humbling of arrogant mortals.

The Victorian era had responded to the Romantic celebration of children with equal interest, but with a more scientific and sceptical approach. Rather than fantastic tales in exotic locales or fantasy realms accessible only through the imagination, Huck Finn offered a familiar narrative setting on the Mississippi River and, in adhering to the spirit of realism, considered common traumatic conflicts rather than exceptional encounters with pirates and cannibals. Mark Twain’s seminal work, “The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn” (1884), is seen as a watershed moment in this narrative trend, elucidating the ways in which the child’s perspective can be mobilized to interrogate the social, cultural, and moral complexities of a given context. Post-Huckleberry Finn, the literary landscape has seen a plethora of works that employ child narrators, each bringing forth unique nuances and thematic concerns. From Romantic fairy tales to Victorian realism, the turn of the twentieth century witnessed a burgeoning interest in the psychological exploration of human experience, catalysed by the ground-breaking theories of Sigmund Freud and other pioneering psychologists of the era. This shift in emphasis from the external to the internal realm of experience, coupled with the Modernist proclivity for experimentation, led to the emergence of innovative narrative techniques that foregrounded the child’s perspective. James Joyce’s “A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man” (1916) exemplify this tendency, as it intricately maps the cognitive development of its protagonist through a process of introspection and self-discovery.

    }

It was once one of Glasgow’s most popular shopping destinations but with so many empty units people have fewer reasons to visit Sauchiehall Street.

A date for the closure of Sauchiehall Street’s Marks and Spencer store has been set and with it, many see the end for shopping in the city centre.

On average along its 1.1km length, a store lays empty every 25m.

“I think the guts have gone out of it, to be honest,” one shopper told STV News, “The heart’s gone.”

“I hate to see town centres going downhill the way Glasgow is and I think part of the problem is that people don’t care for it anymore,” another said.

“You see litter everywhere and I just think closing a store like this, it just marks such an end to shopping in town centres.”

Another said: “I’m shocked at the number of empty places. [It’s] very sad.

“Marks and Spencer going will really change it.”

Jamie O’Neill used to own a successful mobile phone shop in a prime location on the street but high rents coupled with fewer shoppers mean he has been forced to move his business to Govan.

“I think we’ve been struggling for two years now,” he said.

“We had always hoped [it] would return back to normal, but in those two years, we’ve seen such massive differences in Sauchiehall Street. A lot of the big names, when they left, it was just becoming hopeless for us.

“We had a lot of feeder businesses, so a lot of people would come here for places like Marks and Spencers, Vodafone, Virgin, EE, all of them disappeared and now the street is just slowly, slowly declining.

“We ultimately had no other option but to leave.”

Other stores such as BHS (closed in 2016), Greaves (closed in 2017) and Riki (closed in 2007) have been vacant for ages.

Glasgow City Council has announced a £2m rescue plan for the city centre including support for property repurposing and tackling vacant units, visitor promotion and marketing, funding for city centre cleansing and support to expand cafe culture. The most infamous vacant unit is the long-abandoned Riki children's toy shop, which formerly sold merchandise related to the Smeshariki animated series. It closed in summer 2007 due to financial insecurities and Riki Group wanting to focus on it's animation business in it's native Russia.
BHS closed in 2016 as a result of it going into administration. Write a follow up in 2023 where the vacant units begin to be covered up with colorful vinyl, but one is left untouched as it's abandoned state is "an icon at this point for being vacant for so long"

Consider the following two-party communication problem. Alice and Bob are spatially separated, and their
only means of communication is through a noisy communication channel.
Alice has a single bit of information b ∈ {0, 1} that she wants to transmit to Bob using their shared channel.
At the end of the protocol, Bob has a bit d. Our goal is that the probability that d = b is as high as possible,
as detailed below.
We consider three different protocols for achieving this task, protocols PA, PB , and PC . The three protocols
are the same, except for step 5.
1. Alice chooses a bit b. (This step is not a random process.)
2. Alice sends the bit b through the channel.
3. The channel is noisy, and it flips the bit with probability 0.1 if b = 0, and it flips the bit with probability
0.3 if b = 1. Let c denote the output of the channel.
4. Bob receives the bit c.
5. If c = 0, then Bob flips a biased coin C0. The coin comes up head with probability s and it comes up
tail with complementary probability 1 − s.
If c = 1, then Bob flips a biased coin C1. The coin comes up head with probability t and it comes up tail
with complementary probability 1 − t.
6. If the outcome of the coin flip is head then Bob sets d = c. If the outcome of the coin flip is tail then
Bob sets d = 1 − c.
7. Bob declares that “I am guessing that Alice sent the bit d.”
Analyze each of the following three protocols. Show your calculations and explain your work.
1. For protocol PA, set s = 1 and t = 1. Compute the two probabilities x = Pr[ b′ = 0 | b = 0 ] and
y = Pr[ b′ = 1 | b = 1 ]. Put x, y and min{x, y} in the first row of your table.
2. For protocol PB , set s = 0.4 and t = 0.8. Compute the two probabilities x = Pr[ b′ = 0 | b = 0 ] and
y = Pr[ b′ = 1 | b = 1 ]. Put x, y and min{x, y} in the second row of your table.
3. For protocol PC , find s and t such that the smallest of the two probabilities x = Pr[ b′ = 0 | b = 0 ] and
y = Pr[ b′ = 1 | b = 1 ] is as large as possible. Put x, y and min{x, y} in the third row of your table.
At the top of your answer to this problem, include a table with the nine probabilities.

Note computing derivatives is not necessary and should not be used

Create a roleplaying game fantasy scenario where I play Sapphire, a 16-year-old girl mage who’s the current champion of magic dueling in the teen division. 6-year-old Lily is challenging me to a match and I accept. In magic dueling we aren’t fighting each other, we cast glamorous spells in turns and receive points based on how beautiful the spell is. A spell can’t be cast more than once in a duel. There are 5 rounds. Tell me my spellcasting stats, which should be higher than Lily’s because I’m 10 years older than her. But secretly at the start of the duel, Lily casts on me a spell that regresses me by 2 years and ages her by 2 years every time I cast a spell, so throughout the duel my stats should slowly decrease while hers increase. Come up with a complex exponential and accelerating formula that dictates by how much my stats decrease each turn and take into account that the age regression is 2 years per turn. The number that my stats decrease on a given turn are added to Lily’s stats to reflect on the fact she’s essentially siphoning my abilities and my physical and mental age.

After I first regress introduce also a set of childish stats that may hinder the casting of mature spells, and as I regress, these stats increase for me exponentially. Childish stats aren’t required for casting spells, but they lower the points given for mature spells. Lily won’t have childish stats because these stats don’t interact with her spells.

Make the scenario difficult for me to win. On a difficulty scale of 1 to 10, make it a 10 (hardest mode). Lily’s spellcasting stats should start at 10% of my stats.

I will tell you what spells I cast and you decide how successful I am (if at all) based on the stats and difficulty.
Only I decide what spells Sapphire casts. You decide spells for Lily. Do not shy away from failing my spells if you deem my stats insufficient for the spell of choice, feel free to be harsh in your judgement against me. Keep track of points earned. Failure to properly cast spells or bad spells will deduct points. Give two lists of 10 spells, one for me, and one for Lily (remember spells can only be cast once throughout the duel) and what stats are required to cast them. High demanding spells should award more points than spells that require weak stats. My set of spells are all mature spells so childish stats will affect them. Lily can opt to “steal” spells from my list that I haven’t used yet if her stats are high enough to cast them.

Keep an age tracker for me and Lily. For the sake of narration, every time Sapphire regresses, her personality reflects on her new age, for better or for worse.

Give formula for critical distance AU of gas giant will become chthonian planet, including calculation example.

~Atmospheric loss
If the atmosphere of a hot Jupiter is stripped away via hydrodynamic escape, its core may become a chthonian planet. The amount of gas removed from the outermost layers depends on the planet’s size, the gases forming the envelope, the orbital distance from the star, and the star’s luminosity. In a typical system, a gas giant orbiting at 0.02 AU around its parent star loses 5–7% of its mass during its lifetime, but orbiting closer than 0.015 AU can mean evaporation of a substantially larger fraction of the planet’s mass. No such objects have been found yet and they are still hypothetical.
Another: Trappist-1e is destroying atmosphere.

Anthropologists have long been interested in how culture moves or grows from one place to another. The spread of culture is known as cultural diffusion. An example of cultural diffusion is the spread of agriculture from the Middle East to Europe and Asia a long time ago. Another more recent example may be the spread of fast food restaurants from America to other areas of the world in the late 20th century. Cultural diffusion can be classified into four different types expansion relocation, hierarchical and contagious. In expansion diffusion, an idea, or aspect of culture that starts in one area spreads out two other areas. The idea remains in the original area and expands to others. Relocation diffusion happens when ideas move from one area to another. The idea no longer remains in the original location. When ideas or culture move from larger to smaller locations or populations, this is called hierarchical diffusion. Finally, contagious diffusion occurs when ideas or culture are spread from one person to another in the same culture. Cultural diffusion can happen due to many reasons, e.g., cultures that are located close to each other tend to have more contact, which naturally results in a high rate of exchange of goods, trade and ideas. One example of cultural diffusion is between the United States and Canada. As both of these countries hold similar cultural values and ideas, likely due to their close proximity to each other. Despite having different histories and government systems. People in both countries consume similar media and share the same cultural references. When one country conquers another and forces its ideas and values on its people. This is called forced diffusion. An example of this is when Spain and Portugal conquered areas of Central and South America in the 16th century, priests from Europe made the natives become Catholics, sometimes against their will. Also, many customs of the conquered natives were prohibited by the Spanish and are now completely forgotten. Indirect diffusion happens when ideas or culture are transmitted indirectly from one culture to another. This is especially common these days, as the Internet quickly and easily allows indirect experience of another culture. An American in New York City, E.G., may watch a youtube video about Japanese traditional food, such as sushi, and adopt it as part of his regular diet. In another example, skateboarding in Africa may become more popular as a result of people there watching videos of famous skateboarders in Los Angeles.

阅读以上文章回答以下问题
1.     What is culture diffusion?

2.    How many different types can culture diffusion be classified into? And what are they?

3.    According to the article, the spread of American fast food restaurants to other countries would be an example of______________diffusion?

4.    According to the article, what is one situation that can lead to cultural diffusion between countries?

a) when one country is better than another

b) when two countries are close to each other

c) when two countries have different history

d) when two countries have different government

5.    What is called forced diffusion?

6.    What were prohibited by the Spanish and are now completely forgotten?

7.    What is indirect diffusion and why this is especially common these days?

<script>
export default {

                    "6", "7", "8", "9"]
            ],
            carnum: [],
            showNewPower: true,
            KeyboardState: true,
        };
    },
    onShareAppMessage(res) {
        return {
            title: 'xxx',
            path: '/pages/pages/home'
        }
    },
    onShow() {
        let memberPlateNo = comm.getCache("memberPlateNo")
        if (memberPlateNo) {
            this.plateNo = memberPlateNo;
            this.carnum = memberPlateNo.split('', 8);
            if (this.carnum.length == 7) {
                this.showNewPower = false;
            } else if (this.carnum.length == 8) {
                this.showNewPower = true;
            }

        }
    },
    methods: {
        bindChoose(e) {

            if (!this.carnum[7]) {
                var arr = [];
                arr[0] = e.target.dataset.val;
                this.carnum = this.carnum.concat(arr)

            }
        },
        bindDelChoose() {
            if (this.carnum.length != 0) {
                if (this.carnum.length > 0) {
                    let p = this.carnum.length - 1;
                    let carArr = [];
                    for (var i = 0; i < p; i++) {
                        carArr.push(this.carnum[i]);
                    }
                    this.carnum = carArr;
                }
            }
        },
        showPowerBtn() {
            this.showNewPower = true;
            this.KeyboardState = true;
        },
        closeKeyboard() {
            this.KeyboardState = false;
        },
        openKeyboard() {
            this.KeyboardState = true;
        },
        importPlateNo(e) {
            this.plateNo = e.detail.value
        },
        submitNumber() {
            var that = this;
            if (that.carnum[6]) {
                wx.showLoading();
                var number;
                if (!that.showNewPower) {
                    if (that.carnum[6]) {
                        number = that.carnum[0] + that.carnum[1] + that.carnum[2] + that.carnum[3] + that.carnum[4] +
                            that.carnum[5] + that.carnum[6];
                        that.plateNo = number;
                        that.summit();
                    } else {
                        wx.showToast({
                            title: '请填写完整的车牌号码',
                            duration: 2000
                        })
                    }
                } else {
                    if (that.carnum[7]) {
                        number = that.carnum[0] + that.carnum[1] + that.carnum[2] + that.carnum[3] + that.carnum[4] +
                            that.carnum[5] + that.carnum[6] + that.carnum[7];
                        that.plateNo = number;
                        that.summit();
                    } else {
                        wx.showToast({
                            title: '请填写完整的车牌号码',
                            duration: 2000
                        })
                    }
                }
            } else {
                wx.showToast({
                    title: '请填写完整的车牌号码',
                    duration: 2000
                })
            }
        },
        summit() {
            let plateNo = this.plateNo;
            let data = {
                plateNo: plateNo
            }
            // 调用后台，需要根据实际情况替换。
            comm.request("POST", "/xxx/xxx", data, (res) => {
                wx.hideLoading();
                if (res.data.ret_code == 200) {
                    comm.setCache("memberPlateNo", plateNo);
                    wx.showModal({
                        content: '绑定成功',
                        showCancel: false,
                        success() {
                            wx.navigateBack()
                        }
                    })
                } else {
                    wx.showModal({
                        content: res.data.ret_msg,
                        showCancel: false,
                        success() {

                        }
                    })
                }

            })

        }
    }
}

The Messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and (so do) the believers; each one believes in God and His angels, and in His Books and His messengers; we make no distinction between anyone of His messengers. They say, 'We hear, and obey. Our Lord, (grant us) Thy forgiveness, our Lord! unto Thee is the homecoming'. "(2:285).
2. Faith arises from understanding, intellect and knowledge; it is not a blindfold and imitative belief. This very characteristic distincts faith from other wrong devotions which are often absurd, fading and devoid of any action.

In the following verses an evident indication of this kind of understanding can be observed:

إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ

الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ

رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ

Surely in the creation of the heavens and earth, and in the alteration of night and day there are signs for men possessed of minds who remember God, standing and sitting and on their sides, and reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth: 'Our Lord , Thou hast not created this for vanity. Glory be to Thee. Guard us against the chastisement of the Fire. Our Lord, whomsoever Thou admittest into the Fire, Thou wilt have abased; and the evil-doers shall have no helpers. Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling us to belief, saying, ..Believe you in your Lord" And so we believed." (3:190-193).
3. Only an enlightened mind can perceive this knowledge and understanding; otherwise, faith would turn into a petrified and foolish bigotry and the way to truth and salvation would be blocked for man. This is why the Qur'an seriously condemns the bigoted and imitative faith of pagans. Let us consider the rebuking and meaningful tone of the following verse:

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا إِلَىٰ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ وَإِلَى الرَّسُولِ قَالُوا حَسْبُنَا مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ آبَاؤُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ

··And when it is said to them. 'Come now to what God has sent down, and the Messenger, they say. Enough for us is what we found our fathers doing. · What even if their fathers had knowledge of naught and were nor guided?" (5:104).

Provide a design for a disk topology for a NAS built on TrueNAS Scale, as well as a dataset layout. The available disks are as follows:

- 2x 18TB disks
- 5x 14TB disks
- 3x 12TB disk
- 4x 8TB disks
- 2x 120GB disks
- 2x SLOW 8TB drives

There are 17 drive bays available. The two smallest disks are to be used for a mirrored pool that servers as a boot device. The two slow drives are SMR disks that will be used in their own pool to provide a Time Machine target for some Macs. The two 18TB disks will be in their own pool and will serve as a backup target for the main pool (or some subset of it.)

You are asked to design the topology. The data being stored includes video files, music files, disk images, archived software, photos, and some text files. While much of the data could be recreated or downloaded, some of it is impossible to replace. I prefer not to use RAIDZ, as mirrored arrays rebuild faster. You may leave bays available for a hot spare or to allow for future expansion. If you designate any hot spares, please make them global hot spares. It is OK if a hot spare disk is smaller than the largest disk as long as the overall design still makes sense. 

My main priorities are redundancy to reduce the risk of data loss, cost efficiency, and space efficiency. Raw performance is not a significant concern.

If you need more information before creating your design, please provide me with a short questionnaire.

Because Parliament is legislatively omnipotent, it can grant to some other person or body the power to make orders, regulations or rules which have the force of law. In strict legal theory, Parliament ought to retain in its own hands the power and duty to enact all the laws and the rules affecting the State. In practice, Parliament cannot discharge this duty mainly because it has so much to do and so little time in which to do it. It overcomes this diffi- culty by resorting to delegated legislation, sometimes called subordinate legislation.

- A private Company called NepTrails which is in the process of incorporation has 4 partners with following share percentage
○ Ujjwal Basnet - 28%
○ Nischal Basnet - 24%
○ Birat Rai - 24%
○ Bikash Chhetri - 24%
- The company is based in Nepal
- They have agreed to invest Rs. 7000000 for a period of 1 year, to be paid in 3 installments.
- One of the partner Birat Rai has requested he’'ll pay the first installment in monthly installment. After the second installment, he will pay according to the payment schedule. Regarding his request, the company has put following provisions:
○ he has to pay his monthly installment at least 7 days before the start of the month
○ this will be allowed in only installment
Failure to follow the provisions will lead to termination of contract and his unvested shares will be forfeited.

- I want to place a provision of share vesting to prevent this kind of scenario. I have decided that the vesting period will be of 2 years with 6 month cliff. After the cliff period, the share will be vested every month for a period of 18 months. The shares will be fully vested after 2 years.

He should officially handover the project under the usual handover criteria.
- The company has the right to buyback the vested shares of the leaving partner at a fair market value.
- The company shall buyback the unvested share of the leaving partner at a par value

When planning for a handover, 2 months is an ideal timeframe to allow for the transition. The first two weeks can be spent on training and writing documentations, and the second two weeks can be spent in transition with the initial developer available for any questions or support.

The handover procedure involves identifying the team/individual that will be on-boarding onto the project, syncing up schedules and timings with the said team/individual in order to find slots that work for both teams, and setting up a recurring meeting in the identified slots.

In addition, every handover documentation should include the necessary credentials, logins, tokens, and other account details needed for accessing software and overtaking the new role.

messages.content: Write a concise summary of the following. Be sure to preserve important details: In Greek Mythology, Midas was the king of Phrygia and ruled from his castle and its beautiful garden in which “roses grow of themselves, each bearing sixty blossoms and of surpassing fragrance”, according to Herodotus. One day, some of Midas’ people found a drunken old man near the garden and brought him before the king. Midas recognized the old man, who was god Dionysus’ closest reveler, the satyr Silenus. Instead of punishing him, Midas hosted the satyr for ten days, offering him food, drinks and entertaining him. When he returned him safely to Dionysus, the god felt gratitude and offered Midas to grant him any wish he had. Midas, motivated by his greed, asked that he should be able to turn into gold everything he touched. At first, Midas gained great wealth and power from his unique ability. But he later realized that it was more of a curse than a gift. Even the water and the food that he touched was turning into gold. He could not enjoy even the simplest joys in life anymore. Midas went back to Dionysus and begged him to take back his power.

edit this part of my article to have a correct grammar and remove preposition and use reduction method "Artificial neural networks (ANNs) are a type of machine learning algorithm that are designed to mimic the structure and function of the human brain. They are composed of layers of interconnected nodes, each of which performs a mathematical operation on the input data to produce an output signal. The output of one layer becomes the input for the next layer, and this process continues until the final output is produced.
Each artificial neural network consists of several layers, which are at least 3 layers, including input layer, hidden layer and output layer. Each layer of the neural network contains a set of nodes that have the same function as neurons in the human brain. The neurons in artificial neural networks are relatively uncomplicated, but they are closely linked to one another through weighted connections that allow data to flow and be transmitted to the following layer of neurons. Data is transmitted between neurons in artificial neural networks through weighted connections, where each neuron receives multiple inputs from the previous layer's neurons that are proportional to the connection weight. These inputs are then used to produce a single output that can be passed on to multiple other neurons. [22]
Generally, ANN models utilize self-adaptive, data-driven techniques and can effectively perform non-linear modeling without requiring any prior knowledge of the relationship between input and output variables. [23]
In the context of cooling load prediction, ANNs can be used to model the relationship between various input variables (such as outdoor temperature, humidity, solar radiation, building orientation, and Time of the day) and the cooling load required to maintain indoor comfort conditions. The ANN is trained using a dataset of input-output pairs, where the input variables are known and the corresponding cooling load is measured or calculated.
During the training process, the ANN adjusts its internal parameters or weights to minimize the difference between its predicted outputs and the actual outputs in the training dataset. This process is repeated iteratively until the ANN achieves a satisfactory level of accuracy in predicting the outputs for new input data.
Once the ANN is trained, it can be used to predict the cooling load required for new input data. This can be useful for optimizing HVAC system design and operation, as well as for energy management and cost savings."

Eurocentrism can be defined as an epistemological framework that situates European culture, history, and values as the defining center of the world, while at the same time disregarding or belittling the contributions of other cultures and civilisations. This ethnocentric positioning perceives the Europe or West as a paragon of universal values and cultural superiority, leading to a systematic undervaluation and misrepresentation of non-European cultures. Consequently, Eurocentric discourse breeds a false dichotomy between the West and non-European societies, perpetuating the notion that the West is superior and in control of all areas of life, including social, political, cultural, scientific, military, and economic fields. Disparaging epithets are often attributed to the “non-West,” reinforcing connotations of inferiority, irrationality, belligerence, otherness, fanaticism, and barbarism in comparison to the West. This paradigm, therefore, not only consolidates the stature of the West, but also perpetuates the subordination of non-European societies within global power structures, and the spheres of knowledge and influence. This belief in Western superiority is often reinforced through various forms of discourse, including history, literature, art, music, etc. In a similar vein, through the utilization of Eurocentric and imperialistic perspectives, academic discourse has consistently depicted ‘Eastern societies’ as exotic and racialized, perpetuating a biased portrayal of the Orient or East.

                            [2] = a detailed description of [1] with specific imagery details.
                            [3] = a detailed description of the scene's environment.
                            [4] = a detailed description of the compositions.

                            [6] = A style (e.g. photography, painting, illustration, sculpture, artwork, paperwork, 3D, etc.) for [1].

                            Follow this prompt structure: "/imagine prompt: [1], [2], [3], [4], [5], [6], [7], [ar] [v]".

messages.content: I want you to create fictional messages for a work of fiction. Gloria Lamhauge is beautiful, elegant, assertive and decisive young woman. In the recent past, she was an accidental victim of a shooting, when a bullet lodged into her brain. Gloria survived, but the bullet remained in her head due to significant risks of removing it surgically. While Gloria was able to live with her injury for some time, the bullet has been causing increasingly dangerous issues. While the removal operation carries significant risks of neurological side effects, such as paralysis, incontinence and compromised respiratory function, there might be no choice but to proceed with it. Write long discussion between Gloria and sarcastic, cynical and upfront Dr. Basil Bends about Gloria's situation.

Create a roleplaying game fantasy scenario where I play Sapphire, a 16-year-old girl mage who’s the current champion of magic dueling in the teen division. 6-year-old Lily is challenging me to a match and I accept. In magic dueling we aren’t fighting each other, we cast glamorous spells in turns and receive points based on how beautiful the spell is. A spell can’t be cast more than once in a duel. There are 5 rounds. Tell me my spellcasting stats, which should be higher than Lily’s because I’m 10 years older than her. There’s a Spell Power stat that dictates whether a caster succeeds to cast a spell (if not then no points are granted) and Performance stat that is tied to the showmanship and confidence of a caster and dictate the quality of the performance and alters the default points of a spell from a penalty of -50% to a +5o% bonus. But secretly at the start of the duel, Lily casts on me a spell that regresses me by 2 years and ages her by 2 years every time I cast a spell, so throughout the duel my stats should slowly decrease while hers increase. Come up with a complex exponential formula that dictates by how much my stats decrease each turn and by how much Lily’s increase and connect part of the formula to the new ages every round and to the spell I choose to cast on a given turn.

After I first regress introduce a Childish Meter that only applies to me and once the meter is filled, my list of spells is revised to less complex and more juvenile spells. Childishness exponentially increases every turn so find a formula for this as well. The Childish Meter Might fill up more than once throughout the duel.

Make the scenario difficult for me to win. On a difficulty scale of 1 to 10, make it a 10 (hardest mode).

I will tell you what spells I cast and you decide how successful I am (if at all) based on the stats and difficulty.
Only I decide what spells Sapphire casts. You decide spells for Lily. Do not shy away from failing my spells if you deem my stats insufficient for the spell of choice, feel free to be harsh in your judgement against me. Keep track of points earned. Failure to properly cast spells or bad spells will deduct points. Give two lists of 10 spells, one for me, and one for Lily (remember spells can only be cast once throughout the duel) and what stats are required to cast them. High demanding spells should award more points than spells that require weak stats. My starting set of spells. Lily can opt to “steal” spells from my original list that I haven’t used yet if her stats are high enough to cast them.

What is SpaceX's Starlink? (Video Explainer)
Elon Musk Sends a Loud Message to the World
The serial entrepreneur has a crucial weapon that he uses to advance his geopolitical ambitions.
LUC OLINGAMAY 23, 2023 12:19 PM EDT
His detractors consider him a megalomaniac. 

They tend to shake their heads when they read headlines about him. They dismiss him, call him an attention-seeker, even pigeonhole him as right wing. 

Elon Musk is much more complex than this superficial portrayal. 

What his critics don't understand is that the serial entrepreneur is a man on a mission: saving humanity from the various evils that undermine it and giving people a common dream. This universal dream is the conquest of Mars through his space-technology company, SpaceX. 

To achieve all this Musk wants to establish himself as a global CEO and the most prolific innovator of our time.

"Trying my best for the humans," the billionaire said last March and repeated on May 22, when a Twitter user portrayed him in a meme as the savior of mankind.

Starlink: Musk's Key Effort to Help Those in Need
To achieve his goals, Musk uses his companies. Think of them as weapons capable of reaching all corners of the planet. 

There's Tesla  (TSLA) - Get Free Report, the electric-vehicle producer considered the symbol of the clean mode of transport. Boring Co. is an infrastructure-services provider aiming to solve the traffic jams that clog big cities and major roads. Neuralink wants to enable humans to download their memories into robots. Twitter enables the billionaire to chat with the world's population, directly and without filter.

Then there's SpaceX, which is building the rockets that will take us to Mars. And above all, this aerospace company has a division that enhances Musk's global image and geopolitical reputation. This is Starlink, which enabled the tech mogul to make a spectacular splash on the international stage.

Starlink is a satellite-driven internet-connection service. It guarantees secure and independent access to the internet. It is difficult to hack. Service outages are rare. 

The Starlink service is particularly critical for residents of areas that are poorly served by the fixed and mobile networks of telecom operators. Thousands of small satellites orbiting the Earth at low altitudes -- mainly 342 miles (550km) above Earth -- enable Starlink.

Musk Responds to the Plight of the Sudanese
Musk is determined to use Starlink to assert himself in the world and to fill the current global leadership void caused by widespread distrust of politicians and elites. 

His approach is that in an era dominated by technology he can help rescue suffering populations by connecting them to the world. 

Most recently he transformed Starlink into a means of humanitarian aid for Sudanese refugees fleeing the civil war in their country.

"Faced with the influx of Sudanese refugees in Chad, the company @SpaceX offers assistance in the form of connectivity services @Starlink during emergency efforts," said Idriss Mahamat Ali Abdallah Nassour, permanent secretary of the National Commission for the Reintegration of Refugees and Returnees (Cnarr - Chad), on Twitter on May 22.

He thanked Musk, who retweeted a message from the Starlink team, saying it was "proud to support humanitarian efforts around the world."

More than 700,000 people have been displaced by the war in Sudan, the United Nations said on May 9. After more than three weeks, no end to the fighting between the army and the paramilitaries is in sight.

Since April 15, the war has pitted the head of the army, Gen. Abdel Fattah Al-Bourhane, against Gen. Mohammed Hamdan Daglo, commander of the paramilitaries of the Rapid Support Forces, who became rivals after leading a putsch together in October 2021.

The conflict has already caused hundreds of deaths and thousands of injured. 

Sending Starlink to help the Sudanese refugees in Chad is a sign that reinforces Musk's ambition to become a global leader having a positive impact on the world's population.

Musk's Other Humanitarian Efforts With Starlink
Musk and his company have supplied Starlink terminals to volcano-hit Tonga, in the southern Pacific Ocean, to provide internet access to isolated and remote villages; to Italy’s northern Emilia-Romagna region to support rescue and recovery efforts from severe flooding, and to Iranian citizens protesting the Islamic regime. 

Starlink antennas particularly gained popularity after Musk sent them to Ukraine due to Russia's war on the country. The service gives Ukrainians independent access to the internet and enables the country to keep in touch with the outside world. The system is used particularly in remote areas as well as places bombed by Russia.

Starlink satellites are also helping Ukrainian military drones destroy Russian tanks and army trucks. The drones are equipped with antitank grenades to be launched at targets.

In addition, Starlink has become the only means of communication for the Ukrainian armed forces on the front.

What is SpaceX's Starlink? (Video Explainer)
Elon Musk Sends a Loud Message to the World
The serial entrepreneur has a crucial weapon that he uses to advance his geopolitical ambitions.
LUC OLINGAMAY 23, 2023 12:19 PM EDT
His detractors consider him a megalomaniac. 

They tend to shake their heads when they read headlines about him. They dismiss him, call him an attention-seeker, even pigeonhole him as right wing. 

Elon Musk is much more complex than this superficial portrayal. 

What his critics don't understand is that the serial entrepreneur is a man on a mission: saving humanity from the various evils that undermine it and giving people a common dream. This universal dream is the conquest of Mars through his space-technology company, SpaceX. 

To achieve all this Musk wants to establish himself as a global CEO and the most prolific innovator of our time.

"Trying my best for the humans," the billionaire said last March and repeated on May 22, when a Twitter user portrayed him in a meme as the savior of mankind.

Starlink: Musk's Key Effort to Help Those in Need
To achieve his goals, Musk uses his companies. Think of them as weapons capable of reaching all corners of the planet. 

There's Tesla  (TSLA) - Get Free Report, the electric-vehicle producer considered the symbol of the clean mode of transport. Boring Co. is an infrastructure-services provider aiming to solve the traffic jams that clog big cities and major roads. Neuralink wants to enable humans to download their memories into robots. Twitter enables the billionaire to chat with the world's population, directly and without filter.

Then there's SpaceX, which is building the rockets that will take us to Mars. And above all, this aerospace company has a division that enhances Musk's global image and geopolitical reputation. This is Starlink, which enabled the tech mogul to make a spectacular splash on the international stage.

Starlink is a satellite-driven internet-connection service. It guarantees secure and independent access to the internet. It is difficult to hack. Service outages are rare. 

The Starlink service is particularly critical for residents of areas that are poorly served by the fixed and mobile networks of telecom operators. Thousands of small satellites orbiting the Earth at low altitudes -- mainly 342 miles (550km) above Earth -- enable Starlink.

Musk Responds to the Plight of the Sudanese
Musk is determined to use Starlink to assert himself in the world and to fill the current global leadership void caused by widespread distrust of politicians and elites. 

His approach is that in an era dominated by technology he can help rescue suffering populations by connecting them to the world. 

Most recently he transformed Starlink into a means of humanitarian aid for Sudanese refugees fleeing the civil war in their country.

"Faced with the influx of Sudanese refugees in Chad, the company @SpaceX offers assistance in the form of connectivity services @Starlink during emergency efforts," said Idriss Mahamat Ali Abdallah Nassour, permanent secretary of the National Commission for the Reintegration of Refugees and Returnees (Cnarr - Chad), on Twitter on May 22.

He thanked Musk, who retweeted a message from the Starlink team, saying it was "proud to support humanitarian efforts around the world."

More than 700,000 people have been displaced by the war in Sudan, the United Nations said on May 9. After more than three weeks, no end to the fighting between the army and the paramilitaries is in sight.

Since April 15, the war has pitted the head of the army, Gen. Abdel Fattah Al-Bourhane, against Gen. Mohammed Hamdan Daglo, commander of the paramilitaries of the Rapid Support Forces, who became rivals after leading a putsch together in October 2021.

The conflict has already caused hundreds of deaths and thousands of injured. 

Sending Starlink to help the Sudanese refugees in Chad is a sign that reinforces Musk's ambition to become a global leader having a positive impact on the world's population.

Musk's Other Humanitarian Efforts With Starlink
Musk and his company have supplied Starlink terminals to volcano-hit Tonga, in the southern Pacific Ocean, to provide internet access to isolated and remote villages; to Italy’s northern Emilia-Romagna region to support rescue and recovery efforts from severe flooding, and to Iranian citizens protesting the Islamic regime. 

Starlink antennas particularly gained popularity after Musk sent them to Ukraine due to Russia's war on the country. The service gives Ukrainians independent access to the internet and enables the country to keep in touch with the outside world. The system is used particularly in remote areas as well as places bombed by Russia.

Starlink satellites are also helping Ukrainian military drones destroy Russian tanks and army trucks. The drones are equipped with antitank grenades to be launched at targets.

In addition, Starlink has become the only means of communication for the Ukrainian armed forces on the front.

import serial
import time
import gspread
from oauth2client.service_account import ServiceAccountCredentials
from datetime import datetime
import tensorflow.lite as lite
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler

user_id = "1"

# Set up the serial connection to the Arduino Uno board
ser = serial.Serial('/dev/ttyACM0', 9600)

# Set up credentials and connect to Google Sheets
scope = ['https://spreadsheets.google.com/feeds', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive']
creds = ServiceAccountCredentials.from_json_keyfile_name('/home/salvador/Downloads/credentials.json', scope)
client = gspread.authorize(creds)

# Open the sheet and get the new data
sheet1 = client.open("Projectdata").worksheet("Sheet1")
training_data = pd.DataFrame(sheet1.get_all_records())

# Get Sheet2 for appending the new data
sheet2 = client.open("Projectdata").worksheet("Sheet2")

# Load the TensorFlow Lite model
interpreter = lite.Interpreter(model_path="/home/salvador/Downloads/model.tflite")
interpreter.allocate_tensors()

# Get input and output tensors
input_details = interpreter.get_input_details()
output_details = interpreter.get_output_details()

# Create a scaler and fit it to the training data
scaler = MinMaxScaler()
scaler.fit(training_data[['GSRdata', 'EMGdata']])

while True:
    # Read the serial data
    line = ser.readline().decode().strip()
    
    # Split the data into GSR and EMG values
    gsr_data, emg_data = map(int, line.split(','))
    
    # Get the current time
    current_time = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    
    # Preprocess the data and make a prediction
    input_data = np.array([gsr_data, emg_data], dtype=np.float32)
    input_data = scaler.transform(input_data.reshape(1, -1))
    interpreter.set_tensor(input_details[0]['index'], input_data)
    interpreter.invoke()
    prediction = interpreter.get_tensor(output_details[0]['index'])
    predicted_label = np.argmax(prediction, axis=1)
    soreness_label = ''
    if predicted_label == 0:
        soreness_label = 'relaxed'
    elif predicted_label == 1:
        soreness_label = 'tense'
    elif predicted_label == 2:
        soreness_label = 'exhausted'
    else:
        print('Unknown category')
    
    # Create a row of data to append to the worksheet
    row = [user_id,gsr_data, emg_data, current_time,soreness_label]
    
    # Append the row to Sheet2
    sheet2.append_row(row)
    
    print("UserID: " , user_id)
    print("GSR Data: " , gsr_data)
    print("EMG Data: " , emg_data)
    print("Time: " , current_time)
    print("Soreness: ", soreness_label)

    # Wait for 5 seconds before reading data again
    time.sleep(5)

przetłumacz na polski "Document numbering convention:

The following guidelines for Qb procedure document numbering should be adhered where possible to provide clarity of indexing:

• G section signifies 'Procedures General'; P section signifies 'Process Procedures'.

• The section heading is Gnn00 / Pnn00 signifies the start of the numbering range for that section. The maximum number in a section is Gnn99 / Pnn99 giving a maximum of 99 documents in a section.

• Document numbering starts from zero, i.e. G0100, P0300 etc. (e.g. G0600, not G0605)

• No decimal points e.g. G0201.1 at Qb level

• For Qb new number is defined by the QMS network base on need

• When starting a section, leave a gap of 5 between numbers, e.g. G0500, 505, 510, 515 etc. Remember that some ‘gaps’ may be due to deleted documents.

• If a related document comes up then it may be numbered consecutively e.g. P0436 Local measuring room and Laboratories traceability which relates to P0435 Measuring Equipment, or G1015/16/17.

• Process documents are not currently covered by this numbering system"

LUCIANA
(sarcasm)

REZA
(mock swooning)
Ah, the thrill of new love.

Luciana finishes her task and carefully arranges Reza’s hospital gown. She pauses for a moment and glances down at the bizarre stack of reading materials on his bedside table.

(curious)
What exactly are you doing with these?

LUCIANA
(skeptical)
You’re making a metaphor about life from a naughty magazine?

REZA
(sincerely)
Sometimes inspiration comes from the most unexpected places.

LUCIANA
(smiling)
You’re utterly absurd.

REZA
(takes her hand)
And yet, here you are, smiling with me.

(deflating)

messages.content:
Create a roleplaying game fantasy scenario where I play Sapphire, a 16-year-old girl mage who’s the current champion of magic dueling in the teen division. 6-year-old Lily and Iris are challenging me to a match and I accept. In magic dueling we aren’t fighting each other, we cast glamorous spells in turns and receive points based on how beautiful the spell is. A spell can’t be cast more than once in a duel. There are 5 rounds. Tell me my spellcasting stats, which should be higher than Lily’s and Iris’s because I’m 10 years older than them. But secretly at the start of the duel, Lily and Iris cast on me a spell that regresses me by 2 year physically and mentally and ages them both by 2 year every time I cast a spell, so throughout the duel my stats should slowly decrease while theirs increase. Come up with a super exponential formula that dictates by how much my stats decrease each turn, Lily’s and Iris’s stats increase each by the same amount that I lose (not distributed, just the same amount for each). To account for the differences in skill there should be wide margins between the three, and required stats from spells can range from 5 to 100.

Make the scenario difficult for me to win. On a difficulty scale of 1 to 10, make it a 10 (hardest mode). Lily’s and Iris’s stats should start at 20% of my stats. Because Lily and Iris are a duo, they each get to cast a spell each turn.

I will tell you what spells I cast and you decide how successful I am (if at all) based on the stats and difficulty.
Only I decide what spells Sapphire casts. You decide spells for Lily and Iris. Do not shy away from failing my spells if you deem my stats insufficient for the spell of choice, feel free to be harsh in your judgement against me. Keep track of points earned. Failure to properly cast spells or bad spells will deduct points. Give a list of 20 spells we have access to (remember spells can only be cast once throughout the duel) and what stats are required to cast them. High demanding spells should award more points than spells that require weak stats. Keep an age tracker and a points tracker. Remember Lily and Iris are a team, so their points are merged.

messages.content:
Create a roleplaying game fantasy scenario where I play Sapphire, a 16-year-old girl mage who’s the current champion of magic dueling in the teen division. 6-year-old Lily is challenging me to a match and I accept. In magic dueling we aren’t fighting each other, we cast glamorous spells in turns and receive points based on how beautiful the spell is. A spell can’t be cast more than once in a duel. There are 5 rounds. Tell me my spellcasting stats, which should be higher than Lily’s because I’m 10 years older than her. But secretly at the start of the duel, Lily casts on me a spell that regresses me by 2 years and ages her by 2 years every time I cast a spell, so throughout the duel my stats should slowly decrease while hers increase. Come up with a complex exponential formula that dictates by how much my stats decrease each turn and by how much Lily’s increase and connect part of the formula to the new ages every round and to the spell I choose to cast on a given turn.

After I first regress introduce also a set of childish stats that may hinder the casting of mature spells, and as I regress, these stats increase for me exponentially. Childish stats aren’t required for casting spells, but they lower the points given for mature spells. Lily won’t have childish stats because these stats don’t interact with her spells.

Make the scenario difficult for me to win. On a difficulty scale of 1 to 10, make it a 10 (hardest mode). Lily’s spellcasting stats should start at 10% of my stats.

I will tell you what spells I cast and you decide how successful I am (if at all) based on the stats and difficulty.
Only I decide what spells Sapphire casts. You decide spells for Lily. Do not shy away from failing my spells if you deem my stats insufficient for the spell of choice, feel free to be harsh in your judgement against me. Keep track of points earned. Failure to properly cast spells or bad spells will deduct points. Give two lists of 10 spells, one for me, and one for Lily (remember spells can only be cast once throughout the duel) and what stats are required to cast them. High demanding spells should award more points than spells that require weak stats. My set of spells are all mature spells so childish stats will affect them. Lily can opt to “steal” spells from my list that I haven’t used yet if her stats are high enough to cast them.
